inputs.text: Missile launched from North Korea toward the east; projected to pass over northern Japan (Hokkaido / Aomori).

fields.description: Missile launched from North Korea toward the east. It is projected to pass over northern Japan: Hokkaido and Aomori Prefecture. Take shelter now.
fields.headline: Missile launched from North Korea, may pass over Hokkaido and Aomori
fields.instruction: Go inside a sturdy building or underground right away. If no building is nearby, take cover or lie flat and protect your head.
left_out: No unverified inputs were received, so nothing was excluded.
Launch time, flight-over time, impact or landing area, and an all-clear time are not in the inputs, so the alert gives no time or end time.
fields.note_for_reviewer: Certainty is set to Likely because the overflight is a projection, not observed. The sheltering instruction is standard J-Alert missile guidance and is not taken from the inputs. Confirm it matches current Cabinet Secretariat wording, and confirm this message also goes to Aomori, which was added at 07:29.
